Get Public Cloud Id Info
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/publicCloudAccountIdStatus

Lists public (Cloud Connector) cloud account status information (enabled/disabled).

Responses
​
default

Default Response. See API Response Codes

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
accountIdEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether public cloud account is enabled.

subIdEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether public cloud subscription is enabled.
